catcher.songTitle: The Tallest Man, the Broadest Shoulders (Part I: The Great Frontier — Part II: Come to Me Only with Playthings Now)
catcher.line: The boxer, the fetcher, the chewing gum, dream catcher
stanza: The prairie, the frontier, the perfect farm, it's from here
The fortress, the faker, the cornerstone, the baker
(Run for your life, for your friends)
The dancer, the fisher, audition and the disher
The boxer, the fetcher, the chewing gum, dream catcher
